title: termal_read_mailbox_message returns 404 for the messageId that a successful cross-host termal_send_to_session just returned
outcome: The messageId returned by termal_send_to_session can always be read back with termal_read_mailbox_message by the sender, including for a relay (cross-host) recipient. If a status read is unsupported for that route, the error names the route and the supported alternative instead of a bare 404.
acceptance: Root cause identified with file:line: why the messageId returned for a send to a remote (relay) recipient, e.g. the Mac Engram Runner, does not resolve in termal_read_mailbox_message (e.g. a local vs relay id namespace, or a lookup scoped to the local store).

Behavioral regression: a send to a relay recipient returns an id that the sender can read back with the message-status tool, OR the tool refuses with a typed, readable error naming the relay route and the supported alternative (the relay mailbox page and its receipt). Never a bare 'mailbox message not found' for an id the host itself issued.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
